items.label: Define Work Tree, Phase, Checklist, Context Document, and Evidence Target without conflicting with Node and Truth State.
items.evidenceTarget: Glossary and operating rules describe the terms with separate responsibilities.

items.label: Add schema support for Work, Phase, and Checklist records.
items.evidenceTarget: Schema and loader tests reject malformed Phase and Checklist records.

items.label: Add semantic validation for references, cycles, active phase conflicts, and missing checklist targets.

items.label: Generate a SQLite projection without making SQLite canonical.
items.evidenceTarget: SQLite projection tests verify table content and .gitignore keeps the database untracked.

items.label: Expose Work task, Phase, and Checklist status in the read-only control room.
items.evidenceTarget: Component tests show task phase and checklist targets without providing GUI editing.
